notes: P3-OPT-049: MAP-P3 parameter sweep — vary ONLY entry_threshold (= bb_k, the Bollinger band entry deviation multiple).
Single variable change: entry_threshold 2.0 -> 1.8. All other params identical to baseline.

Mechanic: lowering bb_k tightens the bands (bb_upper/lower move closer to bb_mid), so more 1m bars breach the band and trigger entries. Entry threshold for both long (close < bb_lower) and short (close > bb_upper) becomes easier.

Hypothesis: tighter bands admit more frequent but less extreme reversion signals. If OOS Sharpe is unchanged or improves -> the 2.0 cutoff is too strict (we are leaving alpha on the table). If Sharpe drops materially -> the 2.0 cutoff is needed to filter noise.
